name: Haixiang Sun
role: Ph.D. student in the Edwardson School of Industrial Engineering
bio: I’m Haixiang Sun, a Ph.D. student in the Edwardson School of Industrial Engineering at Purdue University, advised by Dr. Andrew Liu. I work at the intersection of machine learning and optimization to make decisions more reliable under uncertainty.

My research brings the structure of optimization into learning systems, spanning differentiable optimization, optimal transport, and scalable machine learning, with applications in energy scheduling and beyond.

research.title: Decisions under uncertainty
research.summary: Learning decision rules that remain reliable when data is limited, distributions shift, or rare events occur.

research.title: Differentiable optimization
research.summary: Bringing optimization into neural networks through differentiable layers and implicit models.

research.title: Scalable & reliable ML
research.summary: Developing scalable learning methods for reliable decision making, with a focus on generalization and large language models.
